instruction: Download and apply the Yaru GTK theme from gnome-look.org to change your desktop appearance.

metadata.explanation: Task requires downloading and installing Yaru GTK theme from gnome-look.org and activating it. Evaluator uses gsettings to verify gtk-theme is set to 'Yaru'. Uses existing check_list metric with cache_file getter.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses 'gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.interface gtk-theme' to verify GTK theme setting
check_list metric appropriately uses regex matching to find 'Yaru' in gsettings output
Postconfig properly executes gsettings command to capture current theme state
Minor imprecision: regex pattern 'Yaru' is too loose - gsettings returns output like "'Yaru'" (with quotes), and the pattern would match any substring containing 'Yaru'
More robust pattern would be '^'Yaru'$' or "'Yaru'" to ensure exact match of the theme name
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider using more precise regex pattern: "^'Yaru'$" or "'Yaru'" in expected.expect to ensure exact theme name match
Alternatively, use pattern "^'Yaru(-dark)?'$" if both Yaru and Yaru-dark variants should be accepted
